litigation.mdlName: In re: Paraquat Products Liability Litigation
litigation.court: U.S. District Court, Southern District of Illinois

phaseDetail: A confidential Master Settlement Agreement was executed September 3, 2025. Case Management Order No. 24 gives the special master access to information concerning settlement qualification, eligibility, and opt-outs. In June 2026, the court selected certain opt-out cases for limited discovery. Bellwether trials remain vacated while the program is administered; new cases continue to transfer into the MDL.
updateNote: August 3, 2026 JPML pending-action count added; the prior snapshot remains listed for month-to-month comparison.
defendants: Syngenta Crop Protection LLC / Syngenta AG

settlements.label: Master Settlement Agreement
settlements.detail: Executed September 3, 2025, according to Case Management Order No. 24. The public court orders do not provide settlement tiers, a payout grid, or an average per-claim value. The court selected certain opt-out cases for limited discovery in June 2026.

keyDates.label: MDL-3004 established
keyDates.detail: JPML centralized federal paraquat cases before Chief Judge Nancy J. Rosenstengel in the Southern District of Illinois.

keyDates.label: Master Settlement Agreement executed
keyDates.detail: Confidential agreement identified in Case Management Order No. 24, which describes the special master's settlement-administration responsibilities.

keyDates.label: Opt-out depositions ordered
keyDates.detail: The court ordered targeted depositions of opt-out plaintiffs at three firms amid reported high opt-out rates.
